title: Bat.Jf 0 2 jackfruit: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: Bat.Jf 0 2 jackfruit: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: Bat.Jf 0 2 jackfruit is a jackfruit variety from Vicente Macasaet. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Bat.Jf 0 2 is a registered jackfruit variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1992. Vicente Macasaet bred it.

heroImage.alt: Young fruit trees planted in straight rows on cleared red soil, the kind of farm where Bat.Jf 0 2 jackfruit is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [jackfruit variety finder](/crop-varieties/jackfruit), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for fruit trees](/land-preparation/fruit-tree-land-preparation).
When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. The mother tree of Bat.Jf 0 2 was about 6 to 10 meters tall when it was registered. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.
The pests and diseases that hit jackfruit fields most often: [mealybug](/pests/mealybug). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit of Bat.Jf 0 2 weighs about 19300 grams, and its shape is oblong. The flesh is dark yellow and smooth and firm.
Where and when to plant Bat.Jf 0 2 jackfruit

Pick a selection by flesh: firm and crisp for fresh eating and processing, or soft and sweet. Grafted trees of a named selection bear true. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Bat.Jf 0 2?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
